baseline.scope: Diagnostic on exact in-flight x86 owning executable; not a replacement for the full root gate.

cause: FNSTSW AX precedes FSTP through an input pointer assigned RAX. The lateout constraint incorrectly permits input/output register overlap before that input has been consumed.
repair: All eight native_x87 status operands use out("ax"), excluding its overlapping register aliases from every input.

primary_reference.title: The Rust Reference: Inline assembly
primary_reference.revision: unknown; official live reference fetched on recorded date

assumptions.assumption: The failing process ran the captured executable and actual native-reference instruction sequence.
assumptions.basis: Owning executable SHA-256 plus disassembly; isolated one-test failure.
assumptions.dependent_result: Register lifetime error explains the observed native pushed result remaining zero.
assumptions.stress_test: FPTAN and FSINCOS both retain the pushed-result address across FNSTSW.
assumptions.falsification_probe: Disassembly has no buffer pointer in RAX at FNSTSW or the binary differs from the captured SHA-256.

bounded_scope.item: Incorrect native-reference constraints can silently corrupt memory or invalidate differential results.
Rosetta execution is not a physical Intel architectural oracle; no discrepancy is attributed to Rosetta.
